And before anyone asks, I am not rich, my parents grew up in poverty. I consider my to self to be sucessful, at least for my age, and generally have strong moral values (don't drink, party, am a virgin, etc) and am looking for a partner who shares similar values. All my friends know this. Your routine sounds like a thoughtful and intentional way to start your day! Taking the time to blend foundation smoothly and perfect your eyeliner not only enhances your appearance but also sets a calm, confident tone for the day ahead. It’s a great reminder that self-care begins with how you present yourself. 

If you ever want to streamline the process (without sacrificing quality), here are a few ideas:  
- **Prep work**: Use a hydrating primer and a quick facial mist to make foundation apply more evenly.  
- **Efficient tools**: A damp beauty blender or a brush with soft bristles can help blend foundation faster.  
- **Eyeliner hack**: A liquid liner with a fine tip or a gel liner can be easier to control for precise lines.
